register.labelZh: ASK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: ask after somebody 可以用來問候某人;ask for somebody 則可以表示要求與某人交談。；ask for something 可以表示索取所需的事物;ask around 則可以表示向多人打聽資料。；ASK 片語動詞可以清楚表示某人是同行、進入房間、到你家作客,還是活動後跟你回去。；ask somebody along、ask somebody round 和 ask somebody out 表示不同類型的邀請。選用正確表達,可以令意思更清楚。
register.summaryEn: Ask after somebody lets you enquire about a person’s wellbeing, while ask for somebody lets you request to speak to that person. Ask for something lets you request what you need. Ask around helps you obtain information from several people. ASK expressions can show whether someone is joining your activity, entering a room, visiting your home or returning with you after an event. Ask somebody along, ask somebody round and ask somebody out describe different kinds of invitations. Choosing the correct one makes your meaning much clearer.
